answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the nadir checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The dune graph is rebuilt each epoch, which means the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the jetty audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 5 times its size, so a group of 11 keys loses far more than 11 single identities would. That is 8 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
